vocab.description: 5112 German words ordered by level and frequency; version 1.1 gives words with two meanings a card for each

changes: Vocabulary 1.1: 112 words with two unrelated meanings now have a card for each meaning (zu: to / too, die Bank: bank / bench …); the new card comes right after the original
Vocabulary 1.1: new example sentences that show the meaning of the card, and wider English meanings (tschüss: bye, goodbye)
New Words follow the learning order of the vocabulary; words added before your position come first
Update Progress page: words added to the vocabulary before your position can be skipped (marked as taught)
Review: a clear message when the chosen topic or level has no taught words yet, with a button to review all taught words
New page Preferences (menu, Settings): keyboard, articles, learning rules and review intervals; Update Progress keeps only your progress
Phones: the app's own keyboard (QWERTY with ä ö ü ß, or QWERTZ) with Check and Next keys; a compact card while typing
Typing German: a card with several forms accepts any of them in any order (der/die/das: die, das der…)
New page About & Licence: sources of the vocabulary and the licence
